turns.sql:
WITH order_counts AS (
    SELECT c.customer_id,
           c.customer_name,
           COUNT(o.order_id) AS num_orders
    FROM Customers c
    JOIN Customer_Orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name
),
max_count AS (
    SELECT MAX(num_orders) AS max_orders FROM order_counts
)
SELECT oc.customer_id,
       oc.customer_name,
       oc.num_orders
FROM order_counts oc
JOIN max_count mc ON oc.num_orders = mc.max_orders
ORDER BY oc.customer_name;
